encounters.introProse: From the shadows of the marble sepulcher rises Lord Karas the Undying! His ancient iron broadsword glimmers with eldritch cold as his glowing empty eye sockets lock upon you!

victoryOutcome.text: Lord Karas crumbles into spectral dust, leaving behind his martial treasures and the radiant Sunstone!

addJournalChronicle.title: Vanquished Lord Karas
addJournalChronicle.text: Defeated the ancient warlord Karas in his sunken tomb and claimed the Sunstone.

encounters.introProse: A savage bristle boar erupts from the tangled brambles with a ferocious snort, charging directly at you!

victoryOutcome.text: You bring down the heavy boar, claiming valuable tusks and prime meat for camp provisions.

encounters.introProse: A terrifying shadow stalker descends from the sharp obsidian pinnacle, howling as razor talons gleam!

victoryOutcome.text: The shadow stalker dissipates into dark vapor, leaving a flawless obsidian crystal upon the rocks.

randomEncounters.introProse: A prowling timber wolf stalks out from behind a cluster of pines, growling low in its throat!

randomEncounters.title: A Traveling Merchant on the Road
randomEncounters.narrative: A friendly peddler with a mule stops to exchange greetings: 'Safe travels, wayfarer! The roads are peaceful today, thank the gods.' He shares some dried figs (+3 Stamina).

randomEncounters.title: An Ancient Roadside Altar
randomEncounters.narrative: You stumble upon an archaic stone marker carved with blessing runes. Pausing to pay respects fills you with resolute focus (+15 XP).
